name: Wanted: "Hogger"
summary: In southwestern Elwynn, Hogger has turned back every local attempt to bring him down. The Alliance bounty posted outside Goldshire seeks the head of this massive, savage gnoll chieftain.

sections.title: A Menace in the Woods
sections.body: Banditry and kobold infestations trouble Elwynn Forest, while gnolls in the south grow bolder and more organized under Hogger's brutal leadership. Taller than typical Riverpaw gnolls, he has made camp near the Forest's Edge. From there, he ambushes travelers and overpowers the local militia patrols sent to subdue him.

sections.title: Goldshire's Desperation
sections.body: The Stormwind Army is stretched thin and cannot spare regular forces to police the capital's outskirts. So Marshal Dughan has taken the unusual step of posting an open bounty on Hogger. Hunting him means venturing into deeply hostile gnoll territory. His ferocity has earned him a fearsome reputation among novice adventurers in Elwynn.

faq.answer: Hogger is an unusually large and savage gnoll leader who terrorizes southwestern Elwynn Forest. He commands local packs around the Forest's Edge and has violently defeated every previous attempt by Stormwind guards to capture or kill him.
Hogger wanders among the gnoll encampments in southwestern Elwynn Forest, near the southern borders known as Forest's Edge. The area lies just north of the river boundary with Westfall and Duskwood.

faq.q: Why is there a bounty on Hogger?
faq.answer: Hogger has overpowered local patrols and poses a lethal danger to travelers, prompting the Stormwind Army to place a bounty on him. With official troops stretched thin across the kingdom, Marshal Dughan has turned to independent adventurers and bounty hunters to eliminate the threat.

faq.q: Who collects the proof of Hogger's death?
faq.answer: Bring proof of Hogger's demise, his Huge Gnoll Claw, directly to Marshal Dughan. He commands the local garrison stationed in Goldshire.

faq.q: Why is Hogger so dangerous compared to other gnolls?
faq.answer: Hogger is far larger and more brutal than the common gnolls prowling Elwynn. He hits significantly harder and can withstand far more punishment, often overwhelming anyone who faces him alone and underestimates him.

faq.q: Why can't the Stormwind guards handle Hogger themselves?
faq.answer: The kingdom's military resources are severely depleted and tied down defending major borders or dealing with the missing King Varian Wrynn. Marshal Dughan's small detachment in Goldshire lacks the manpower to hunt down such a resilient monster safely.

angles.text: For Alliance heroes, taking down Hogger is a rite of passage as they test their mettle defending Stormwind's heartland.
For humans of Elwynn, slaying Hogger secures homesteads and road trade that gnoll ambushes have terrorized for months.
